parameters.name: ExecutionNamePrefix
parameters.description: The prefix of the execution name.

parameters.name: FlowName
parameters.description:
The name of the flow. The name must be unique within the same region and cannot be changed after the flow is created. The name must meet the following requirements:

- Can contain letters (a-z and A-Z), digits (0-9), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- Must start with a letter (a-z or A-Z) or an underscore (\_).

- Is case-sensitive.

- Must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of executions to query. The value must be in the range of \[1, 100]. The default value is 60.

parameters.name: MapRunName
parameters.description:
The name of the MapRun. When a MapRun is started in an execution, a MapRunStarted event is generated. You can get the MapRunName from the output of the MapRunStarted event.

You can set MapRunName to filter child executions started by a specific MapRun in the current flow.

parameters.name: MetadataOnly
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only the metadata of the executions. If you set this to true, the response does not include the flow definition, input, or output. If you set this to false, the response includes all data.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to start the query from. Obtain the token from the response of this operation. This parameter is not required for the first query.

parameters.name: Qualifier
parameters.description: The version or alias of the flow.

parameters.name: StartedTimeBegin
parameters.description: Filters for executions that started after this time. The time must be in the UTC RFC3339 format.

parameters.name: StartedTimeEnd
parameters.description: Filters for executions that started before this time. The time must be in the UTC RFC3339 format.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the executions to filter. Valid values:

- **Starting**

- **Running**

- **Stopped**

- **Succeeded**

- **Failed**

- **TimedOut**
